about_the_game:
The concept of time and space just changed. A soul shattered and you are caught in the middle. Find out who or what was strong enough to rip time apart and why only your soul shattered. There is one goal - Recover your soul and "repair" time in the process!

"It always hides where you’ve already searched." 

               

                

Despite Time is a ground breaking Action RPG with a fast paced battlesystem featuring any weapon you can imagine. Be it a common one like a sword, bow or handgun or special ones like a scythe or magic. Combine all of these to your liking. Why not having a sword in one hand and a gun in the other? Or maybe just use your bare fists. 

Explore fantasy worlds of endless possibilities. From dark fantasy dungeons to cyberpunk cities. From fighting pirates on a ship to a duel at high noon!

These worlds in form of Dungeons regenerate each time you enter them, creating different routes and possibilities of yet unseen secrets to discover. The rooms are handcrafted with attention to detail to bring you immersive and ever changing worlds.

Every piece of armor on enemies can be dropped and equipped. Mix and match the armor that suits your playstyle the best.

But we all know, it's all about fashion, therefore we have a skin system in place, so you can change your appearance without having to miss out on your favorite stats.

You'll also find Modifiers which can apply elemental effects to your attacks, make projectiles split, homing or bouncing and much more.

While you traverse the diverse timelines, there is a lot of loot to be found. Even though Equipment, Style and Modifiers are important, there is more you can do to get stronger.

The unique character progression also allows you to get stronger at the things by actually doing them. Doding a lot makes your dodges more reliable, parrying consistently results in stronger counter attacks. Using a weapon unlocks new abilities for its type and so much more.

content_descriptors.notes: The game features depictions of violence, blood and suicide, and imagery that some players may find disturbing. The game contains revealing outfits and partial nudity.
